# defectdojo_product (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a DefectDojo product by ID or name. DefectDojo 3.x shows products as *assets*.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "defectdojo_product" "by_name" {
  name = "Storefront"
}

data "defectdojo_product" "by_id" {
  id = 7
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the product to look up. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) The name of the product to look up, compared exactly and case-sensitively. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `authorized_users` (Set of Number) The IDs of the users who may access the product, in addition to superusers, staff and the authorized users of its product type.
- `business_criticality` (String) The business criticality of the product, or null.
- `description` (String) The description of the product.
- `disable_sla_breach_notifications` (Boolean) Whether the notifications of SLA breaches of the product's findings are disabled.
- `enable_full_risk_acceptance` (Boolean) Whether findings can be risk-accepted with a risk acceptance form.
- `enable_product_tag_inheritance` (Boolean) Whether the product's engagements, tests and findings inherit its tags.
- `enable_simple_risk_acceptance` (Boolean) Whether findings can be risk-accepted with a checkbox.
- `external_audience` (Boolean) Whether the product is used by people outside the organization.
- `internet_accessible` (Boolean) Whether the product is accessible from the internet.
- `life_cycle` (String) The lifecycle of the product, or null.
- `origin` (String) The origin of the product, or null.
- `platform` (String) The platform of the product, or null.
- `product_manager_id` (Number) The ID of the product manager, or null.
- `product_type_id` (Number) The ID of the product type of the product.
- `regulation_ids` (Set of Number) The IDs of the regulations that apply to the product.
- `sla_configuration_id` (Number) The ID of the SLA configuration of the product.
- `tags` (Set of String) The tags of the product.
- `team_manager_id` (Number) The ID of the team manager, or null.
- `technical_contact_id` (Number) The ID of the technical contact, or null.
